title: Plumber Technician | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Plumber Technician. Category: Vocational Training Courses. Duration: 4 months. Description: Pipe fitting (PVC, CPVC, GI, PPRC, Copper Pipes). This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
